messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident fired (INC-45432) for inference-eu-prod: high 5xx rate on /v1/generate — paging oncall.
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: page fired -> INC-45432; urgency: high; escalation policy: inference-sre; triggered by: 5xx-rate-alert.
ash: grabbing this — just woke up but reachable. what's the current customer impact?
tess: seeing ~20% of requests return 5xx, some customers reporting timeouts in EU region, dashboard shows burst at 03:40 UTC.
mike: confirmed, logs show spike of backend `model-proxy` returning 502 -> likely an upstream model pool saturating.
ash: ok, first responder plan: 1) pause noncritical autoscaler actions, 2) drain new requests to fallback pool, 3) open bridge if needed.
lucy: @ash I can take customer liaison / comms. I'll DM Support for a live list of affected accounts and post updates.
ash: assigning ownership to myself for now. pd note: `pd ack INC-45432 --owner ash` (hand-typed, will use console too).
ash: quick mitigation attempt: flipping routing policy to allow burst->dedicated pool (manual route). issuing command now:
```
# route override
curl -X POST https://console/internal/routing/override -d '{"policy":"burst-to-dedicated","ttl_sec":600}'
```
mike: saw rollback logs from `route-controller` a minute ago complaining about capacity quotas. might need to bump quota on the dedicated pool first.
tess: support posted affected customers in #support-ops — 3 medium-size customers with production traffic impacted, one on a live demo.
lucy: posted a short heads-up to the customers and set expectation: "we're investigating, isolating traffic, ETA 20–30m" — waiting on engineering mitigation.
ash: checkpoint: tried manual override, got `quota_exceeded` from dedicated-pool-control. fallback: scale-up dedicated pool by +2 gpus and retry.
mike: starting scale-up now, ETA ~4m. I'll monitor KV/cache pressure as well.
incident-bot: update logged: INC-45432 -> ash (owner); note: manual routing attempted; capacity scale pending.
ash: if scaling fails we have Plan B: enable best-effort degraded mode (shorten context length) to reduce mem usage — that'll reduce quality but keep service alive.
tess: customer-liaison update sent at 03:47 UTC. will post another at 04:00 with status and next steps.
mike: dedicated pool scaled +2 GPUs successfully at 03:48:12 UTC, route override retried -> success. 5xx rate dropping.
ash: good — watching metrics. errors down from 20% -> 1.8% in last 3m. keeping oncall ownership for stabilization and postmortem.
lucy: support will follow up with impacted customers and offer extended credits if they were on demos.
ash: timeline + next steps: keep route override for 10m, validate no regressions, collect logs and traces for postmortem, assign postmortem owner.
tess: suggest postmortem owner = mike (runtime infra), with ash as incident commander for notes. agreed?
mike: can take postmortem. will start collecting kernel traces and autoscaler events.
incident-bot: INC-45432 status: acknowledged -> in-progress -> owner: ash; participants: ash, mike, tess, lucy; last update 1791234123.
ash: handing off to morning shift at 06:00 UTC. will add context in the PD incident and link traces. leaving detailed runbook steps in the incident channel.
lucy: thanks — I'll ping morning oncall with customer list and current mitigation state.
ash: final note before short break: if 5xx creeps above 5% re-escalate to tier2 and open public status note. :thumbsup:
